_what: Per-kit config for the JOIN-1 sprite-cell renderer (join1_render/scripts/render_cells.gd + index_cells.py). The renderer is generic; everything kit-specific is here. -- v2 (2026-09-30): the same kit on the v2 clips (every clip on its Meshy source's own 30 fps keys; release_s re-derived); renders into join1_pack_draft/d2-fire-sorc_v2/ and supersedes the declared v1 pack, which is not touched

h_model.method: rest pose, the body mesh (char1) skinned at rest by the runtime importer: crown (max up) minus sole (min up), metres

layers._what: the pass-2 staff hold (so_d7 export manifest, staff_hold.carry_layer): a filtered Blend2 at weight 1 takes the listed bones from the carry pose. chest_arm (2026-09-30, the pack review): hit's layer -- Spine02 + the staff arm, so the staff stays inside the idle carry's lean while her head and the rest of the spine still flinch (so_d7 work/s17_hit_flinch.json)

morphs._what: grip_R = 1 while the staff is held (every state); grip_L only with the off-hand IK, which is OFF everywhere

cast_hand._what: the casting hand's PALM (wrist + 0.07 m along the hand): the LEFT hand (the Fire Ball hand, her free hand) in every state but cast_meteor, where the RIGHT hand calls it

head_top._what: the top of the head: the head_end joint

main_grip._what: the staff grip: the weapon_r joint (the fist's channel centre)

main_tip._what: the staff's crown end: weapon_r + 0.8765 m along its +Y (the staff spans -0.8713 .. +0.8765 m there; the Meteor's baked slide moves weapon_r and the tip with it)

_notes_from: states.<s>.notes_from: manifest paths whose text the indexer copies into matrix_index.json states.<s>.notes (2026-09-30: each clip's window on its Meshy source, so the next reader does not re-find it)

supersedes.why: v1's idle, hit, death and both casts were keyed at 24 fps, and the runtime glTF path the renderer and the game both use (Godot 4.6.3 GLTFDocument.generate_scene) re-samples every track at 30 fps: v1 rendered its 24 fps clips as their 30 fps bake -- at its release frames the casting forearm 5.0 deg (Fire Ball) and 3.6 deg (Meteor) off the file's own keyed pose -- and each of those clips began with a held first pose. v1's release_s were also one 24 fps frame early on its own clips (s5 counted from frame 1). v2 re-cuts every clip on its source's own keys, so the bake is key-for-key, and re-derives release_s on the shipped keys. The declared v1 pack is immutable; it matches what the game played at the time
